maplibre-contour
================

Version: 0.1.0
Upstream: https://github.com/onthegomap/maplibre-contour
Distribution source: https://registry.npmjs.org/maplibre-contour/-/maplibre-contour-0.1.0.tgz
Retrieved: 2026-08-07
Licence: BSD-3-Clause, "Copyright (c) 2023, Michael Barry and maplibre-contour
contributors" — the author of planetiler. Same licence family as MapLibre itself.

Runtime dependencies: none. The published package declares no `dependencies` at
all, so this one file is the whole of it.

Files retained:

- index.min.js — UMD browser distribution defining `globalThis.mlcontour`.
  31,197 bytes raw, 10,607 gzipped. It inlines its own web worker as a blob,
  so there is no second file to serve.
- LICENSE — upstream licence.

Not retained: `index.js`, `index.cjs`, `index.mjs` (the same code unminified and
in other module formats — this app loads MapLibre itself as a global script, so
UMD is the format that matches), the TypeScript declarations, and `src/`.

WHAT IT IS FOR
It registers a MapLibre protocol handler — the same `addProtocol` mechanism
PMTiles uses — that reads the app's existing `raster-dem` source, stitches
neighbouring tiles so lines do not break at seams, and emits real vector tiles
of isolines by marching squares. That means contour intervals become a runtime
choice rather than a build-time one, and it retires the contour GeoJSON this app
used to ship.

THE RELEASE CADENCE IS A KNOWN CAVEAT, NOT A SURPRISE.
0.1.0 was published 2024-12-21 while commits on `main` run to 2026-04-18, so
this tarball is the 2024 code and does NOT include the newer protocol worker.
That was a deliberate choice: this repository pins reviewed versions by policy,
and the newer work is not published. Do not "fix" this by pointing at `main` or
at a CDN. See docs/changes/map-timeline/contour-sources-2026-08-07.md § 6.

TWO BEHAVIOURS MEASURED HERE, 2026-08-08, THAT THE UPSTREAM DOCS DO NOT MENTION:

1. CORRECTED 2026-08-08, having first been recorded here the wrong way round.
   The map DOES fire `idle` with the protocol registered - it waits for the DEM
   tiles the tracer fetches itself, which are 437 KiB each and 10.3 MiB for one
   view. Unthrottled that is 1.65 s; at 3 Mbps it is 36 s; below that it exceeds
   any sane timeout. The earlier "never fires idle" was three reproductions inside
   one slow network window, and neither the worker nor the timeout was the cause.
   Plan for the BANDWIDTH, not for a missing event.
2. Its default `timeoutMs` of 10 s is not enough against this project's DEM host,
   whose tiles are 437 KiB and take a measured 4.27 s median at six concurrent.
   It is set to 30 s here, from that measurement.

See docs/changes/map-timeline/live-contours-2026-08-07.md.

Do not replace these with `@latest` URLs or a runtime CDN. Pin a reviewed
version, update this record and the checksums below, and re-run the map's
browser gates whenever the dependency is upgraded.
